newsitem.title: FRANCE: Casino stock falls after H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Casino stock falls after H1 results.

text.p: Shares in retail group Casino were down in early afternoon trading on the bourse on disappointment with its first-half operating results, brokers said.

Casino reported a 44.8 percent surge in net attributable profit but an eight percent rise in operating profit. The gains were due to the performance of its Casino USA unit and a drop in financial expense to 160 million francs from 208 million.
Its exceptional gains were 70 million in the first half of 1996, up from 20 million a year ago.
One trader said its domestic performance was disappointing given Casino's dependence on its home market.
Traders said rival Carrefour appeared to be a better buy. Its shares were up 1.45 percent at 2,798 francs, while Casino's stock was down two percent at 213 francs.
